stories.title: Buss asks court to block siblings' vote to sell
stories.summary: In a petition filed in L.A. Superior Court, Jeanie Buss is challenging the legality of her siblings' vote to sell the family's remaining Lakers shares.

stories.title: Kuminga joining Wolves on 2-year, $12.4M deal
stories.summary: Jonathan Kuminga agreed to a two-year, $12.4 million deal with the Timberwolves, which includes a player option, his agent told ESPN's Shams Charania. Part of Minnesota's pitch is that Kuminga will fill the vacant starting power forward slot.

stories.title: Goodell discusses York arrest, says review ongoing
stories.summary: Commissioner Roger Goodell said the NFL is looking into whether 49ers owner Jed York will be punished for violating the league's personal conduct policy after he was caught in a prostitution sting in Ohio.

stories.title: PCA, Cubs fume after umps' miss: 'Get it right'
stories.summary: The Cubs and star outfielder Pete Crow-Armstrong were left fuming Wednesday after umpires missed a pivotal balk call in what ended up being a 2-0 Chicago loss to the Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix.

stories.title: NFL axing Pro Bowl Games, will still honor players
stories.summary: The NFL is eliminating the Pro Bowl Games, instead shifting the focus to celebrating the honor of being a Pro Bowl selection.
